candidateProfile.narrative: Parjanya Modi is a founding engineer at Clueso (YC W23), where he owns backend systems and infrastructure. He designed and shipped the company's CI/CD platform and architected two production media systems (ClueCast video delivery and MediaFlux distributed processing). Before Clueso, he worked as an SRE intern at CRED and a DevOps engineer at Ankercloud, progressing from freelance web development to infrastructure ownership at a YC-backed startup.

readiness.summary: Strong founding-engineer behavior. Independently architected Clueso's CI/CD system and moved into media infrastructure (ClueCast, MediaFlux), both undefined platform problems. 57 original GitHub repos and persistent side-project activity (certitude-cli, firebase-exporter, learning Rust/Go) suggest natural bias toward creating structure where none exists.
evidence: Designed and shipped CI/CD system that Clueso engineering team runs on today
Architected ClueCast (CDN-backed video delivery) and MediaFlux (distributed media processing) as company-wide infrastructure
57 original GitHub repos spanning tools, learning projects, and end-to-end systems

readiness.summary: Repeatedly converts ambiguous infrastructure problems into production systems. Built CI/CD pipelines, CDN-backed video delivery network, and distributed media-processing platform at Clueso. 68% documentation coverage across GitHub repos indicates bias toward maintainability. However, 0% CI coverage and 8% testing coverage suggest execution discipline may be inconsistent outside high-stakes production environments.
evidence: Shipped production CI/CD, video delivery (ClueCast), and media processing (MediaFlux) systems at Clueso
0% CI coverage and 8% testing coverage across public repos

readiness.summary: Consistently chooses difficult, high-leverage environments. Joined Clueso as founding engineer after CRED (security SRE) and Ankercloud (DevOps). 57 original GitHub repos over 2,129 days, including self-directed learning (Rust, Go), blockchain tooling, and infrastructure automation. However, 0 active repos in last 90 days and no sustained open-source contributions suggest ambition may be channeled primarily into private work.

57 original GitHub repos spanning diverse domains (IoT, blockchain, media, infrastructure)

readiness.summary: Pivoted across domains repeatedly: freelance web development → DevOps/SRE → founding engineer backend/infra. Moved from frontend-heavy work (React, JavaScript) to infrastructure (CI/CD, media processing, distributed systems) to security (CRED SRE). GitHub shows learning projects in Rust and Go alongside production JavaScript/React work. However, low testing/CI coverage and lack of recent public activity suggest adaptability may be more reactive than proactive.

Clueso (YC W23) - Founding Engineer Topics
AUGUST 2024 - PRESENT
CI/CD Pipelines
Built and optimized deployment pipelines using Jenkins & GitHub Actions for 
large-scale multi-service environments, enabling automated testing, zero-downtime 
deployments, progressive rollouts, and reliable rollback workflows.
Media Infrastructure
Architected and implemented ClueCast, a CDN-backed SSR-powered video delivery 
network with adaptive HLS streaming, optimized caching, and scalable content 
delivery. Built MediaFlux, a distributed media-processing platform that offloads 
heavy FFmpeg workloads from API services through custom orchestration and 
horizontal scaling.
Developer Platform & Tooling
Built internal platforms and tooling to streamline engineering workflows, 
including a CLI-driven local development stack for automated Docker networking 
and service provisioning, and a self-service cloud development environment 
manager that provisions preconfigured EC2 instances with required repositories 
and environments.
Infrastructure Security
Strengthened infrastructure security, improved internal tooling, and actively 
owned system design and infrastructure decisions across services. Played a key 
role in compliance audits and platform reliability initiatives.
Developer Experience
Built internal tools to improve debugging and operational visibility. Led 
monorepo modernization efforts by migrating Yarn → PNPM and Lerna → Turborepo, 
improving build performance, dependency management, and developer productivity.
Authentication, Billing & Access Control
Architected and maintained GatePass, the organization's centralized 
authentication, authorization, and billing platform. Designed secure access-
control workflows and successfully migrated production authentication from Auth0 
to PropelAuth without impacting live traffic.
Platform Integrations
Integrated the product with HubSpot and other business systems to improve funnel 
tracking, operational visibility, and business intelligence capabilities.
System Design & Architecture
Continuously evolved platform architecture to support scale, reliability, and 
faster delivery cycles. Led the decomposition of a monolithic application into 
15+ independently deployable services, improving performance, deployment 
velocity, fault isolation, and reducing user-facing downtime.
